before.damage_basis: client character counters; includes overkill; excludes healing

after.damage_basis: client character counters; includes overkill; excludes healing

skill.name: 横扫架势
skill.description: <@ba.rem>可以在下列状态和初始状态间切换：</>\n防御力<@ba.vdown>-{-def:0%}</>，攻击距离<@ba.vdown>缩短</>，攻击力<@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>，阻挡数<@ba.vup>+{block_cnt}</>，同时攻击阻挡的所有敌人，每秒恢复最大生命的<@ba.vup>{HP_RECOVERY_PER_SEC_BY_MAX_HP_RATIO:0.0%}</>

skill.name: 自动掩护
skill.description: 下次治疗使目标获得一个持续<@ba.vup>{duration}</>秒的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>\n屏障可以吸收相当于闪灵攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的伤害，同时使目标防御力<@ba.vup>+{def:0%}</>；<@ba.rem>可充能{ct}次</>

skill.name: 缺水的大洋裂断
skill.description: 下次攻击会将目标<@ba.vup>较大力度地</>拖拽至面前，并对其造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害\n<@ba.rem>可充能{cnt}次</>
